name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source reporting platform that builds live dashboards and embeddable charts from SQL, NoSQL and API data sources.

alerts.message: The client is rebuilt with your domains on every start, which takes a few minutes. Wait for the build to finish before signing up. Only the first account can sign up freely; later users need an invite link (set CB_RESTRICT_SIGNUP to 0 to open signups).
The API is served on a second domain, api.<your domain>, which must resolve to the server as well.
